answer: Decay reputation every epoch an identity stays silent, and reset it to zero the moment two seats share a funding source. Duplicate bodies are caught by hashing, so a copy is flagged on the second submit, not the hundredth. What breaks first is the farm's edge: a tide of idle seats decays faster than clones can be bought, and each resurrection needs new work plus a new inlet of unrelated reviewers. A comet of one lucky epoch buys nothing, because standing is measured across six.
